introDescription: Match incoming CVs to your roles and prepare AI screening calls.
loginDescription: Sign in to your Frontdesk account.
signupDescription: Create an account to access your Frontdesk workspace.
name: Full name
invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
duplicateEmail: An account already uses this email. Sign in instead.
invalidPassword: Use a password between 8 and 128 characters.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
requestFailed: We could not complete your request. Please try again.
accountDescription: You are signed in to Frontdesk.
googleFailed: Google sign-in could not complete. Please try again.
googleCancelled: Google sign-in was cancelled. You can try again or use your password.
googleLinkRequired: This email already has an account. Sign in with your password, then link Google in Settings → Account.
googleAccountMismatch: Choose the Google account with the same email as your Frontdesk account.
googleEmailUnverified: Google must verify your email address before you can use it to sign in.
accountSettingsDescription: Manage how you sign in to your Frontdesk account.
googleLinkDescription: Link the Google account with your Frontdesk account email. Your existing businesses, openings and candidates stay with this account.
googleLinked: Google is linked to this account.
googleNotConfigured: Google sign-in is unavailable until the server is configured.
googleMailboxSeparate: Authorize Gmail separately in Integrations to collect CV attachments.
